title: CloudEventEnvelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0.2 structured-JSON envelope every domain and platform event shares (API-40). A message's own payload schema is its `data` property's schema; this file only fixes the envelope fields every event carries.

specversion.description: CloudEvents core attribute (this envelope is CloudEvents 1.0.2, whose wire specversion is '1.0').

type.description: Event type and major version together (FR-K.3's 'event type and version'), e.g. com.dynokore.gst.submission.SubmissionAcknowledged.v1.

subject.description: The aggregate key, usually the Doc UUID where the event concerns a document (FR-K.3's 'Doc UUID where applicable').

docsequence.description: Per-document, monotonic sequence on document-scoped events only (INV-REQ-1221; renamed from 'sequence' 26 Sep 2026, standards review). Absent on an event that is not document-scoped.

instanceid.description: The emitting service instance (FR-K.3's 'emitting service and instance'; 'source' names the service).

data.description: The message's own payload, not this envelope's concern.
